_comment: Sample plans for the counselor page (Courses and recommended sequence). Figures come from the LBCC catalog program sheet for Plan Code 2150 (supplied by Vincent 2026-09-07), the catalog course entries, and the LBCC-GE pattern. Anything flagged confirm:true still needs Vincent's or Counseling's eye; while any flag is set the section ends with a 'Draft for review' line. The AI courses come from the content collection; program.json holds the ladder.

sources.text: LBCC catalog program sheet, Artificial Intelligence for Digital Transformation, Associate in Science (Plan Code 2150): six AI courses + CS 31, COSP 38, COSN 250; then LBCC-GE or Cal-GETC (27–34 units) and electives numbered 1–599 as needed to reach 60 degree-applicable units; units for the major may double-count for GE
LBCC catalog course entry, CS 31 Introduction to Computer Science–Python: 4 units, 72 hours lecture

LBCC-GE pattern (2026–27 catalog): English Composition; Oral Communication and Critical Thinking; Mathematical Concepts and Quantitative Reasoning; Arts and Humanities; Social and Behavioral Sciences; Natural Sciences; Ethnic Studies; Lifelong Understanding and Self-Development; American Institutions and Ideals
LBCC 2025–2026 Noncredit Catalog: COSA 660 Fundamentals of Generative AI, 54 hours lecture, noncredit
LBCC online catalog (current requirements, course descriptions, GE course lists)

supporting.title: Introduction to Computer Science – Python
supporting.note: The catalog course entry is 4 units (72 hours lecture); the program sheet prints 3 and a 28-unit subtotal. Shown here at the course's catalog value; the sheet is being corrected.

supporting.title: Cloud Computing in Amazon Web Services

ge.unitsNote: LBCC-GE is nine areas, one course each, 3 units minimum per area (27 units); the program sheet gives 27–34 units for the GE options, the upper figure being Cal-GETC for students who plan to transfer. Some approved courses are 4 units (for example ENGL C1000 and STAT C1000), which only reduces the electives needed. Units for the major may double-count toward GE; a counselor confirms which.

areas.name: Oral Communication and Critical Thinking
areas.example: COMM C1000 Introduction to Public Speaking

areas.name: Mathematical Concepts and Quantitative Reasoning
areas.note: Statistics pairs well with AI 40 and satisfies the mathematics proficiency.

areas.name: Arts and Humanities
areas.example: PHIL 7 Introduction to Ethics, or an art history or literature course
areas.note: Ethics here complements the program's ethics-first approach.

areas.name: Natural Sciences
areas.example: an introductory biology, earth or physical science course

areas.name: Lifelong Understanding and Self-Development
areas.example: a health, kinesiology or personal-development course

areas.name: American Institutions and Ideals
areas.example: POLS C1000 American Government, or a U.S. history course

electives.note: Electives are any degree-applicable courses numbered 1–599, taken as needed to reach 60 units. With the 29-unit core and 27-unit LBCC-GE, most students need one course, two if every GE course is 3 units. The program recommends choosing it to sharpen a focus.

focus.why: For students who will build and publish the assistants, pages and content they prototype in AI 60 and AI 65.
Extends COSP 38 and AI 40: the data an automation runs on, and the dashboards that show whether it worked.
Context for AI 70 and AI 80: where workflows come from, who owns them, and how a change is justified.
Recommended preparation for CS 31; a gentle first course for students who have never written code.

noncredit.title: Fundamentals of Generative AI
noncredit.note: Free, noncredit, no enrollment fee: the noncredit twin of AI 45, listed in the AI 60 outline as recommended preparation (as AI 645). A way in for a student, or an employee, who is not ready to enroll for credit.

degreePlan.title: Full-time, four semesters
degreePlan.note: About 15 units a term. At half that load the same plan takes eight semesters; the order stays the same. AI courses go in the recommended order, the supporting courses sit beside the AI course they help most, and two or three general-education courses a term keep the load balanced.

semesters.name: Semester 1
semesters.milestone: AI Literacy (Certificate of Accomplishment, 6 units) earned

semesters.name: Semester 2
semesters.milestone: AI Fluency (Certificate of Achievement, 12 units) earned

semesters.name: Semester 4
semesters.milestone: AI for Digital Transformation (Certificate of Achievement, 18 units) and the A.S. degree earned

certificatePlans.note: Both courses can be taken in the same term; neither has a prerequisite.
AI 60 and AI 65 may be taken in either order, or together.
AI 80 (the capstone) recommends AI 70 first. A student in a hurry can take AI 70 and AI 80 in the same term, since recommended preparation is advisory, and finish in three semesters.
